name: Omri "beta_b0t" Ben Bassat
biography: Omri Ben-Bassat is a vulnerability researcher with over a decade of experience in reverse engineering, vulnerability finding, binary exploitation, and low-level vulnerability analysis, specializing in IoT and embedded systems. He has presented his work at leading security conferences, including Black Hat USA, Black Hat Asia, and RSA Conference, and has delivered awesome hands-on trainings at Black Hat Asia and TyphoonCon. Omri is currently pursuing a master's degree at Tel Aviv University, where his research focuses on applying formal methods to software exploitation.
